_comment: ONLY_PROMOTION product (仅推广 / 非授权) — a listing that only promotes and links out (no downloadable file, no license, no price). publish.mjs uploads cover + detail images only; there is NO installer/sourceCodeFile for this form. Rules (see reference.md): no softwareVersion required, no receivePayment.productPrice requirement, no package needed — just coverImage + 3-20 introduce.images. Point buyers to sourceStation / shopLink.

baseInfo.secondName: Drive traffic to the product site
baseInfo.summary: A promotion-only listing that showcases the product and sends interested buyers to the official site / store.

introduce.functions: Showcases features, screenshots and use cases; links out to the vendor site for signup.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Prospects discovering the product through the PowerSoftware storefront.
introduce.usageScenarios: Marketing presence and referral traffic rather than an on-platform purchase.
introduce.painPoints: The vendor wants discovery/leads without selling or delivering files on-platform.
